data.content_ref: inline:REDUCTION: SRC_004's refusal condition—exhaustion inside a causally atomic reasoning step whose internal state was partially flushed—reduces to SRC_005's side-channel leakage condition. The 'partially flushed internal state' in SRC_004 is a specific instance of 'partial fragment has leaked causal state into a side channel' in SRC_005: the flush target (scratchpad, cache, attention state) IS the side channel. Thus SRC_004's independent refusal criterion is not novel; it is a constructive specialization of SRC_005's general principle. The isolated problem depends on recognizing this reduction to avoid double-counting failure modes. REFUTED IF: one can exhibit a case where a causally atomic step was interrupted (SRC_004 triggers) but no state leaked to any side channel the resumed stream would read (SRC_005 does not trigger), proving the conditions are logically independent.
